function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – A Quick Guide When it comes to men’s underwear, “best” is a mix of comfort, fit, durability, and style. Below is a rundown of the most popular styles, what they’re best for, and key features to look for when shopping. | Style | What It Looks Like | Ideal For | Key Features | |-------|--------------------|-----------|--------------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Long‑legged briefs that cover the hips and thighs. | Everyday wear, sports, travel. | • Full coverage, supportive fit.
• Good for preventing chafing.
• Available in cotton, modal, microfiber, and performance blends. | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short‑legged, snug fit that stays in place. | Work, gym, casual. | • Tight support, minimal bulk.
• Great for tight pants.
• Usually made of cotton or a cotton‑blend. | | **Boxers** | Loose, breathable, short‑legged. | Sleep, lounging, light activity. | • Air‑flow, relaxed fit.
• Often made of cotton or bamboo.
• Not ideal for tight pants. | | **Trunks** | Similar to boxer briefs but with a shorter leg. | Modern look, active wear. | • Sleek silhouette.
• Good for low‑rise pants.
• Usually cotton or performance fabric. | | **Jockstrap** | Supportive pouch with a waistband and a thin elastic strap. | Sports, high‑impact activities. | • Excellent support for athletes.
• Minimal coverage, good ventilation. | | **Compression Shorts** | Tight, full‑coverage shorts that compress the thighs. | Athletic recovery, cycling, running. | • Muscle support, reduced vibration.
• Usually made of spandex blends. | | **Bamboo/Modal** | Made from plant‑based fibers. | Eco‑friendly, sensitive skin. | • Soft, breathable, moisture‑wicking.
• Naturally antibacterial. | | **Performance/Tech** | Designed for sweat‑management and odor control. | Sports, hot climates. | • Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor tech.
• Often includes mesh panels. | | **Luxury/Designer** | Premium fabrics, subtle branding. | Special occasions, gifts. | • High‑quality cotton, silk, or cashmere blends.
• Often feature unique stitching or logos. | --- ## How to Pick the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Daily Activities** - **Active Lifestyle**: Go for compression shorts or performance boxer briefs. - **Office/Business**: Classic briefs or boxer briefs keep you comfortable under suits. - **Relaxation**: Boxers or bamboo fabrics are great for sleep or lounging. 2. **Fit Matters Most** - **Waistband**: Should sit comfortably at the natural waist without digging. - **Leg Length**: Boxer briefs should cover the thighs but not be too long; trunks should stop just above the knee. - **Support**: Look for a pouch or supportive seam if you need extra lift. 3. **Fabric Choice** - **Cotton**: Breathable, soft, but can retain moisture. - **Modal/Bamboo**: Ultra‑soft, moisture‑wicking, eco‑friendly. - **Microfiber/Spandex**: Stretchy, quick‑dry, great for performance. - **Silk/Cashmere**: Luxury feel, but less durable for everyday wear. 4. **Durability & Care** - Check the care label: some fabrics shrink or lose shape if washed in hot water. - Look for reinforced stitching at the waistband and seams for longevity. 5. **Budget & Brand** - **High‑End**: Brands like Calvin Klein, Tom Ford, or Lululemon offer premium fabrics and design. - **Mid‑Range**: Hanes, Fruit of the Loom, and Jockey provide good value. - **Budget**: Target, Walmart, and online retailers like Amazon offer affordable options. --- ## Top Picks (2026) | Brand | Style | Why It’s Great | |-------|-------|----------------| | **Uniqlo** | Ultra Stretch Cotton Boxer Briefs | Affordable, breathable, excellent fit. | | **Calvin Klein** | Classic Briefs | Iconic design, high‑quality fabric. | | **Lululemon** | Align Performance Shorts | Moisture‑wicking, supportive, great for running. | | **Tommy John** | Cool Dri Boxer Briefs | Anti‑odor tech, soft cotton‑blend. | | **Bamboo & Co.** | Bamboo Boxer Briefs | Eco‑friendly, silky smooth, antibacterial. | | **Under Armour** | Tech Compression Shorts | Compression support, breathable mesh. | --- ## Quick FAQ | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | **What’s the difference between boxer briefs and trunks?** | Boxers briefs have longer legs; trunks are cut shorter, giving a more modern look. | | **Can I wear boxers under tight pants?** | Not recommended; they’ll shift and cause discomfort. | | **Do performance fabrics smell?** | No, they’re designed to resist odor buildup. | | **How often should I replace underwear?** | Every 3–6 months, or sooner if you notice wear or loss of elasticity. | --- ### Bottom Line The “best” underwear style depends on your lifestyle, body type, and personal preference. For most men, a pair of high‑quality boxer briefs or classic briefs will cover everyday needs. If you’re into sports or want extra support, consider compression shorts or performance fabrics. Always prioritize fit and fabric—those are the real game‑changers. Happy shopping!
